I wanted to tell a story instead.

رحلة سينمائية...
وتحول تدريجي يخلي المشاهد يكتشف إن العالم اللي كان بيتفرج عليه من البداية هو في الحقيقة وجه الساعة.

The goal wasn't just to make the watch look expensive.

The goal was to make time feel monumental.

Everything was created using AI:

Creative Direction
Storyboarding
Product Visualization
Cinematic Camera Movement
AI Animation
Sound Design
Post Production

I believe AI shouldn't just recreate traditional ads...

It should unlock ideas that would be difficult, expensive, or impossible to produce with conventional workflows.

Do you think luxury advertising should keep its traditional style, or is it time to explore more cinematic storytelling powered by AI?
